violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. - Rice in walk-in freezer found uncovered. - Items in walk-in freezer found uncovered.--Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. -Rice and salsa found on ground in walk-in freezer
Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --- Ice cream shop found bleach mixed with soap. - Kitchen sanitizer bucket found at 200ppm CL

Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Food on display for self service was not properly protected by food guards, display cases, or similarly effective means. - Waffle cones not protected from contamination.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. - Hand sink by 3 comp sink not supplied with soap.--Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. - Hand sink by 3 comp sink not supplied with paper towels.

Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room in ice cream shop used by women did not contain at least one covered waste receptacle.--Toilet room in ice cream shop was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --- Wood behind hand wash sink in ice cream shop needs to be painted or sealed.--Carpeting was installed as floor covering where not allowed in storage area in new ice cream shop.
Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. -Milk in ice cream area found on counter at 58F

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical warewashing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration . - Dishwasher found at 0ppm CL, moved dishwashing to 3 comp sink till fixed.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --- Install baseboard in dishroom and other kitchen areas where are openings between wall and floors. - Dishroom: at some point must repaint/repair floor where paint peeled exposed rough concrete.
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Approved, safe, unadulterated, approved additives, proper receiving temperature (4 pts deducted)
Designed, constructed, installed, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
